rule: This taxonomy defines reusable construction families and shared classification dimensions. It does not itself create production library entries, runtime state, canon or universal balance authority.

template_families.name: hook_premise_inciting_situation
template_families.role: Creates reasons to engage, discover, respond, choose or become obligated without hard-coding one solution.

template_families.name: situation_scene
template_families.role: Creates playable social, environmental, logistical, ceremonial, emergency, exploratory or mixed situations.

template_families.name: encounter_archetype
template_families.role: Creates structural encounter patterns across combat, social, investigation, exploration, stealth, chase, survival, hazard, puzzle/problem, travel, political and hybrid play.

template_families.name: objective_stakes_outcome
template_families.role: Defines objectives, stakes, partial success, fail-forward, competing goals, time conditions and non-defeat outcomes.

template_families.name: complication_escalation_reversal_twist
template_families.role: Defines compatible pressure changes, reversals, complications and derailment-recovery material.

template_families.name: encounter_pressure_difficulty_shaping
template_families.role: Defines advisory changes to independent encounter pressure dimensions while preserving uncertainty and no-guarantee rules.

template_families.name: adversary_scaling_role_kit
template_families.role: Defines source-respecting adversary role/capability transformations without universal stat multipliers.

template_families.name: mystery_investigation_clue_kit
template_families.role: Defines revelation, clue redundancy, clue-source alternatives, information gates and failure-resistant investigation structures.

template_families.name: adventure_structure
template_families.role: Defines modular adventure skeletons and branching structures.

template_families.name: session_construction_kit
template_families.role: Defines bounded session structures, pacing shapes and continuity/recovery arrangements.

template_families.name: campaign_architecture
template_families.role: Defines reusable long-form campaign architectures without creating Campaign runtime truth.

template_families.name: npc_dramatic_role_relationship_situation
template_families.role: Defines reusable dramatic roles, motives, debts, secrets, obligations, rivalries and relationship pressures.

template_families.name: reward_aftermath_consequence
template_families.role: Defines information, access, favor, reputation, relationship, sanctuary, obligation and world-state consequence patterns.

template_families.name: genre_tone_reskinning_transformation
template_families.role: Defines expression-layer transformations that preserve governing mechanics and authority boundaries.

template_families.name: discovery_recommendation_profile
template_families.role: Defines intent-first discovery metadata and explanation requirements; not a normal GM-facing giant-list catalog.

template_families.name: composition_recipe
template_families.role: Defines compatibility-aware composition recipes and replace/remix operations over mature construction families.

provenance_origin_types.meaning: A claim or field backed by an identified governed source and exact version.
Original GCL reusable design material authored for the library; not external canon or runtime truth.
A human GM customization derived from a reusable template.
Optional AI-proposed material requiring human review and owning-domain acceptance before mutation.
A local adaptation scoped to a Campaign/Scene/Encounter or other owning context.
Content whose canonical status is established by an external owning domain; GCL only references that status and its evidence.
Nonproduction material used only to prove grammar or validation behavior.

projection_types.purpose: Expose enough bounded, authorized detail for rapid GM use while retaining unresolved requirements and warnings.
Expose replaceable slots, dependencies, substitutions, transformation points and lineage for remixing.

reserved_rules: Later GCL tranches may extend family-specific vocabularies but may not silently redefine shared GCL-01 semantics.
Unknown and unresolved are valid explicit states and may not be replaced with invented defaults.
Discovery tags help retrieval and do not create mechanics, canon, permission or entitlement.
Genre/tone classification describes expression and intent; it does not authorize mechanical reskinning that changes governing rules.
Pressure dimensions remain independent advisory factors and are never collapsed into a universal scalar by this taxonomy.
A template family classification never implies runtime or canonical authority.
